buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 1. Interested bidders/ Service providers / reputed firms providing such services may submit their bids thr ough GeM portal with all the necessary and relevant documents on or before bid submission end date and time. The tenders / quotations received unsigned / incomplete shall be summarily rejected. 2. All the pages of the bid documents being submitted must be signed by the authorized person and sub sequently numbered by the bidder irrespective of nature of content of the documents before uploadin g. 3. The technical bids will be opened first and financial bids of technically qualified bidders alone shall be opened thereafter. 4. Bidder should attach list of the Govt. organization/PSUs/Private parties to whom the bidder is has provi ded service. The list should be uploaded with the bid along with proof. 5. Bidder to upload ITR for last three financial years. 6. Annual turnover of the bidder should not be less than Rs.95 Lakhs during the last three financial years. (2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26). Certificate of turnover to be uploaded with the bid document. 7. Duly Signed, stamped and Scanned copy Certificates like GST Registration, RC Books, Registration Certificate, PUC documents, up to date Insurance Certificate, PAN No. and other relevant documents if any etc. 8. Duly Signed, stamped and Scanned Copy of Tender Acceptance Letter, Tender terms & conditions and Letter of authorization to submit bid. 9. An undertaking (self-certificate) that the agency hasn't been blacklisted by a Central/State/UT Gov ernment institution and there has been no litigation with any government department. 10. The bidder should have a registered and well-established Taxi Agency / Firm having a sufficient nu mber of latest-model taxi cars available for hiring by the Office of the Director, Non-Formal & Adult Ed ucation, Assam. A list of the vehicles proposed to be deployed must be attached with the technical bid

. 11. There are mandatory conditions that, Ø The Registered Office or one of the branch offices of the Agency/ firm must be located in Guwa hati, Assam. The proof of the same to be produced in the form of firm registration certificate updat ed till bid publish. Ø The vehicles which are to be deployed should not be older than make and model of year 2025 . Ø The firm/agency should clearly state in its bid documents that it is not facing any police case, i nvestigation or prosecution. Suppression of such facts shall render the contract liable to terminati on with immediate effect, without notice. Ø Bid are to be given for Petrol and Diesel Vehicles only. Ø Past Experience of last 5 years in Govt. organisations of Deptt. Of Assam to be furnished. 12. Rate for the above should be quoted for hiring of vehicles per day basis. Charges for additional Km s and additional hours should also be indicated as per GeM SLA. 13. In case condition of vehicle is not found to be satisfactory, they shall be returned for immediate re placement. In case no replacement is provided on time, this office would have right to hire vehicles fr om the market and the additional cost incurred by this office will be borne by the supplier. 14. The vehicle may be required to be taken for outstation assignments. In this case driver’s overnigh t/ outstation allowances may also be indicated separately in the price bid as per GeM SLA. However, n o separate calculation of kilometres and Hours will be allowed for outstation tours. Payment for Extra Kilometres and Extra Hours will be made only after exhaustion of the maximum specified kilometres a s per SLA. 15. The Service Provider shall also be required to provide vehicles on an ad hoc or daily-hire basis, as and when required by the Client, for special occasions, events, or other official requirements. The cost POL shall be borne by the Service Provider and included in the quoted rates. 16. The vehicle should be neat and clean and in perfect running condition with clean interiors and pro per upholstery and maintained that way during the tenure of the contract. 17. The service provider would ensure that the Drivers employed have valid driving license with clean driving record. The Driver of the vehicle provided must follow traffic rules and all other regulations pre scribed by the Government from time to time. The Driver shall observe all the etiquette and protocol while performing the duty and shall be neatly dressed in proper uniform and must carry a mobile phon e in working condition, for which, no separate payment shall be made by this Directorate. Drivers depl oyed should be free from any addiction. This Directorate shall not be responsible in any way, if any, h arm to any person or any valuable property is caused by the Driver. 18. The vehicles should be registered with the concerned authority. The service provider shall provide a certificate to this effect. The service provider should be accessible on telephone for contact round th e clock. 19. The tendering authority reserves the right to reject all or any of the offers or accept more than one offer without assigning any reason. 20. A daily record indicating time and distance for vehicle shall be maintained by the Driver in a log b ook in format as per Government instructions and Log Book shall be submitted to the concerned officer of this Directorate regularly for scrutiny. 21. The period of contract shall be for Thirty-Five (35) months or completion of project whichever is ea rlier from the date of entering of the contract. 22. The vehicle must be available at any time of any day as desired by this Directorate. 23. On awarding of the contract, the service provider has to furnish the certified copies of Registration Certificate books and the comprehensive Insurance Policies and PUC to the tendering authority. Servic e provider should provide receipts for payment of GST for the last two years. 24. This Directorate shall be liable to pay the hiring charges only. Contract charges, including charges of Driver, repair and maintenance of vehicle, insurance, fuel, toll tax, oil and any other incidental expe nses shall be borne by service provider. 25. In case of breakdown of any vehicle during official duty, it shall be the responsibility of the service provider to provide a same category substitute vehicle immediately.

26. In case any vehicle does not report on time / does not report at all, the O/o Director, Non-Formal a nd Adult Education, Assam would have a right to hire a vehicle from the market and the additional cos t incurred by the Directorate will be borne by the service provider. 27. There should be at least two sets of white covers, the towels and napkins in the car and should be changed every week. An air spray is must in every car. 28. Vehicles should be kept with sufficient stock of fuel. 29. In case of any accident, all the claims arising out of it shall be met by the service provider. Bidder should ensure that vehicle be covered with appropriate insurance policy. 30. The liability of this Directorate is limited to the contract value only. 31. Vehicles hired shall be provided for exclusive use of this office and shall not be used by the contra cting agency for any other purpose. 32. Service provider must follow labour contract rules and EPF act &other rules at all the times of deliv ery period. 33. Service provider must submit valid documents of vehicles so to be deployed under this contract. S ervice Provider must maintain a sufficient balance in the Fast tag wallet to ensure smooth payment of toll taxes by the driver. Additionally, the Service Provider should ensure that the driver has adequate cash on hand to cover expenses for fuel or other necessities during the journey. 34. The contract between this Directorate and the Service Provider can be cancelled after a notice of 1 month, in case Directorate wishes to cancel the contract before expiry of the period of agreement. 35. Any matter during the period of the agreement, which has not been specifically covered by the agr eement, shall be decided by this Directorate whose decision shall be final and conclusive. In case of a ny dispute of any kind and in any respect whatsoever, the decision of this Directorate shall be final an d binding. 36. Non-compliance with any of the terms and conditions shall amount to breach of contract and in tha t situation, this Directorate shall be free to take necessary action as deem fit, including termination of contract. 37. Bids once submitted shall not allowed to be withdrawn and any default after acceptance of bid sha ll be deemed to be non-compliance of terms of contract and would be liable for penalty levied. The su ccessful bidders shall provide details of all vehicles within 07 days and also present himself for signing the agreement as and when called for. Further, the vehicle are to be provided for duty immediately. 38. A declaration regarding acceptance of the above-mentioned terms and conditions is to be submitt ed along with the bid. 39. No Increase in rate due to escalation cost or due to any other factor would be permitted during the period of the contract. 40. The service provider shall ensure that speedometer and odometer of vehicle are properly sealed a nd no tampering is done with a view to inflate distance travelled. 41. In case the quality of service is found to be unsatisfactory e.g., vehicle is not clean or the driver re ports late, driver is not appropriately dressed or vehicle is not in a good running condition etc., after 3 such instances, this office reserve the right to terminate the contract without any prior notice. 42. No payment shall be made in advance. All payment shall be made on daily basis (as and when ve hicle is required) against the bill duly supported by the duty slip. 43. This office shall be at liberty to withhold any of the payment in full or in part subject to the recover y of penalties. .
